expected_rate: each non-co-held Track B entry on a stock with a fund route (most names; about 1-4 Track B entries per session on 10/09-10/28: 17 entries in 14 sessions).
window_reason: Track B trades on most but not all sessions; five sessions covers several non-10/10 entries.
reversal: a non-10/10 Track B entry still wired at the $140 budget cap; any Track B fund lot whose final stop is under 5 ticks from its entry; any Track B lot of 1 stock share while a fund route passed its checks with 2+ shares; any Track A sizing or stop change; Track B realized P&L (Alpaca fills) below -2% of equity over its next 20 closed lots (owner reviews).

metrics.name: track_b_wired_vs_precap_shares
metrics.bound: wired shares equal the account-room size (no 'track-B exposure cap' clause)

metrics.name: track_b_realized_pnl
metrics.bound: not below -2% of equity over 20 closed lots
